note: F-150 only (NHTSA models F-150, F-150 HYBRID); no score: Ford reports F-150 and Super Duty sales together as F-Series

quotes.text: While driving 15 mph another vehicle ran consumer's vehicle off the road. It hit a rock. Air bags deployed, burning a hole on top of air bags. Dealer has been contacted.
Possible engine failure is causing the vehicle to stall intermittently when reaching the top of a fairly steep hill. Dealer ran diagnostic test but were unable to duplicate the problem.
Consumer states while he driving his vehicle at 45pmh lost the control of the car and hit a telephone pole, neither air bag diden't deploy. Ph
Vehicle "dogs" down (loss of power) when turning right. Only when your turning a corner at low speed does the engine stall. Numerous complaints and replaced parts have not fixed the situation.
The 'newer' supercrews have rear headrests, but the early 2001 models do not. I feel that all versions should have rear headrests.
While driving the vehicle manning fold bracket fell down on the highway. But before it fell hit the gas cable accelerator. Dealer notified.
Spark plug blew out of the head. I hear this has happened to many times to mention. I have a 2002 hd - f-150 with 45,000 miles on it.
2002 Ford f150 caught on fire in the inside of the passenger cabin while parked.
Consumer noticed while traveling a natural gas smell coming through air vents, making consumer sick. Manufacturer and dealer had been contacted.

The 4 wheel drive failed to disengage. The truck has been serviced by several dealerships for this issue. They all gave different solutions to solve the problem, but none of the solutions related to what was in the owner's manual.

Purchased new Ford harley pickup. Loud noise in rear, shop could not identify. Rear axle broke in curve and rear wheel on driver side was several yards from where truck finally ran off road and overturned. Total loss.
2003 Ford f-150 super crew, howling/whining noise from rear differential during accelleration. Noise only occurres between the speed of 40mph and 60mph, most noticable at 50 mph.
When pulling into traffic sometimes transmission slips. This causes vehicle to loose power, and could result in a rear end or frontal collision.

Transmission slipped while driving across an intersection. Consumer was stuck in the middle to the road. When accelerating it shifted out of gear. Metal was found in the transmission. Ford said send it back to manufacturer.
The brakes began to shimmy and shutter and there was vibration from the rear when driving.
2005 Ford f150 loss brake pedal pressure. Brake pedal slowly goes to the floor with little or no brakes. Leaks brake fluid out of the master cylinder reservoir from under cap.
Sudden total brake failure on Ford f150 2005. Result of vacuum line popping off of rear intake manifold.
2005 Ford f150 developed extreme front wheel brake pad dust.
Brake defect 2006 Ford 4x4 xlt pickup. Vibration in vehicle when stopping.
2006 Ford f-150 with brake failure. Customer states that the brake pedal fell almost all the way to floor level. He states that the dealer is unable or unwilling to fix the problem.
Random stalling, looses power and completely shuts down everything. 2006 Ford f150.
Valve stems on 2007 f 150 bad valve stems on truck Ford sent out a notice on them after losing 1 tire and spinning 3 other valves every week after Ford would not stand buy the notice on the repairs.
Failure of tire valve stem resulting in a rapid flat tire.
Drove vehicle to work and parked it, when leaving work, opened door of vehicle and there was smoke and flames coming from the vent in dashboard. Vehicle had been idle 7 hours.
2008 Ford f150 consumer stated that vehicle self-accelerated at full throttle.
Brakes failed on 2 separate occasions for no apparent reason. Ran thru 2 different intersections ...no wet roads...no weather conditions...just failed to stop vehicle.
The transmission slips in the 2008 Ford f150 crew cab. Yesterday I put it in reverse and it did not engage. So then I had to put it into park and then engage it again to reverse then it let me go.

Vehicle vibrates at highway speed seems to come from right rear. Have taken it to three dealers they could not fix problem. Dealer stated all 2009 f-150s do the same. Replaced tires but still has same problem.
There is a rattle noise when driving 35-75 mph from the transmission when under load. -2010 f-150 4x4 supercrew.
I was driving and the rear window popped, smelled like an electrical fire. Truck is still at the shop they cannot id the issue I fear that if only the glass is replaced that this issue will reoccur.

Truck was outside at 11 degrees f. Started vehicle and turned on the rear defrost. Within 2 to 3 minutes the left panel(drivers side) of the 3 piece sliding rear window shattered, while stopped at a traffic light.

Issue started again on 10 aug. 2013. When under mild to heavy acceleration (such as merging onto interstates) the engine develops a significant miss and shudder. Vehicle was repaired once on 20 mar. 2013 under tsb # 13-3-3.
Engine misses at times of hard acceleration. Engine ecoboost.
The truck has a bad miss when going up hill , it has had the Ford fix and it still won't run. It's going to get someone killed.
Pulling on the highway and accelerating the truck seems to hesitate when you need the power. This particular day was humid but it happens sometimes in clear weather.
Vehicle lost power while passing another vehicle. Unable to complete passing maneuver. This is a safety issue that needs to be addressed.
When passing and increasing speed, vehicle lost acceleration. No accident occurred but could have caused a head on or other accident.
There is an un-normal vibration when applying brakes. I think the rotors are bad.
Brake rotors are warping quickly; twice with only 25,000 miles. Dealer has turned rotors twice, but not willing to replace rotors.
Brake cylinder failure; took two weeks for repair at Ford dealer.
Brake did not work and pedal just went to the floor. Car was in motion in local mall parking lot.

Total brake failure while towing a 35 foot rv trailer on the highway. Used manual trailer brakes to stop the car and trailer. The car had no brakes and had to be towed. Master cylinder replaced. Recall 16s24 temporary repair.
Driver reported brakes felt spongy in the morning on location. Driver functioned brakes a few time in park and light came on. Checked fluid level and it was low.
Complete loss of brakes due to loss of brake fluid leaking from master cylinder
Back doors latches will not release. I have tried to open them in a heated garage (65 degrees) but to no avail. Dealer has informed me that parts are on a back order and not due till late february.
Manufacturer recall number17s33 NHTSA recall number17v652 I have not been contacted regarding this recall.
My doors fail to re-latch after opening during cold weather. My doors have opened while driving several times when the door is closed and locked without anyone touching the door latch.

When the outside temperature dropped the vehicle locks and door latches stopped working. The doors will not latch, which prevents me from securely closing them. This is effecting all of the doors. Temperature is 32 and below.
Sudden brake loss with no warning lights happens occasionally when coming to a stop. Vehicle doesn't stop all the way
Doors will not close, have to put a heater on them to get them to latch, Ford tells me I'm not apart of the recall, even though the truck has the same symptoms as the recall.
Arrived at work on 12-23-19 at 8 am (walgreens parking lot). Shut my front driver door and the rear window of my f-150 pickup shattered.
My new f-150 front differential leaks. When trying to slow down vehicle I can hear knock sound and around front axle and sudden decelerate.
Door latch freezing and will not latch and unlatch properly in freezing temps. Has been into dealership twice already and was told nothing more they can do for me.
F-150 will sometimes roll when parked on an incline. The problem is intermittent, and the f-150 will not always roll. So far, the f-150 will only roll between 6' to 24'.
In park and truck rolls,and the transmission is severly slipping,and smells like gas

The car showed message â auto startstop shift to p, then restart engine â and lost power on highway, I shift to p and restart engine, the message showed again and couldnât drive. It was very dangerous.
2019 f-150 - 3.5l ecoboost, on a cold start there is a ticking-tapping or rattle noise
Rattle on cold start. Sounds like timing chain rattle or phasers.
Intermintedly when placed in park it after engine is turned off rolls. Sometimes very slow sometimes very quickly. Also key gets stuck in the ignition.
I was turned up a driveway and the truck stalled the warning light said auto start stop put in p and start engine. I turned off auto start stop and put in p and it started
Transmission lunges, shifts erratic, almost got hit entertaining highway
Complete loss of the throttle while in an intersection. Was able to shut down vehicle, then wait about 30 seconds, then turn it back on clears issue. This has happened at least three times
DRL lights are dead after three years of ownership. Dealer wants $1600 per light assembly to repair them. Cannot afford to repair them. makes the truck less visible day and night.
A deafening pop and static sound coupled with a burning electrical smell. Startled me nearly off the Rd.
While driving my entire dashboard went off. No speedometer, No Tach, No fuel gauge, No odometer, nothing. Replaced appropriate fuse still out. Vehicle has just over 36,000 miles
Rear end differential bearing failure, second time. Result in high vibration and substantial metal flacks in differential oil. Ford reporting rebuild is required again.

In park changed mode to 4A and moved shifter to reverse no reverse. Truck in electric mode then engine started and reverse activated. Upon stop shifted to drive and truck would not move. Engine started then truck moved.
Backup camera is blurry and hard to make out what is behind vehicle
Rear light bar has water inside. Recall has not been fix since October 2025. Rear light flickering on and off. Been pulled over by the police
rear axle shaft/hub broken. Rear differential leaking
Instrument cluster display goes black. Random occurrence. Lasts between 5 seconds to 1 minute. Dealer unable to reproduce.

While towing truck shifted harshly and turned on the indicator light (P1744). The truck started having metallic noises while in gear. Dealer inspected and found metal debris throughout transmission. Dealer replaced transmission.

While the manufacture states parts are available, I have not been able to get any and have been waiting since October of 2025. NHTSA Recall Number25V512
Backup camera failure after dealer replaced entire interior main body harness
Complete backup camera failure showing black screen. Third time system has failed.
